text:
Done — I refreshed the UI and split the frontend/backend code into smaller, cleaner files without changing the app’s behavior.

What changed:
- Modernized the look with:
  - softer gradients and glassy surfaces
  - updated card/button styles
  - cleaner spacing, shadows, and badges
  - better mobile-friendly layout behavior
- Refactored frontend JS into smaller pieces:
  - `public/js/api.js`
  - `public/js/ui.js`
  - `public/js/auth.js`
  - `public/js/app.js`
- Simplified and tidied HTML templates:
  - `public/index.html`
  - `public/login.html`
  - `public/signup.html`
- Cleaned up server code structure a bit:
  - `src/app.js`
  - `src/routes/auth.js`
  - `src/routes/tasks.js`
  - `src/config/db.js`
  - `src/middleware/auth.js`

Validation:
- Ran the test suite successfully.

If you want, I can also do a second pass to further break the backend routes into service/helper modules while keeping the same behavior.
